snip.cap: The telegram of 8 August 1910: “Querida Mãe. Recebi sua carta Tudo bem tempo lindo”, then the code groups 36508 50178 37708 97183 …
snip.credit: Arquivo Nacional Torre do Tombo, PT/TT/CAM/M13, image m0015, via DigitArq

system: Telegraphic code of five-digit groups over 00000-99999 with short items 05 and 06, between clear Portuguese openings and closings; not Sabugosa's alphabetical code.
